name: Seiran
source:
A mysterious girl who acts as the guide for the Galaxy Express. She suddenly appears before the protagonist, who has lost everything in life. She's dresses in strange, old-fashioned, conductor-like clothes.
[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/11/30/karudea/]official website[/url]]
[spoiler]Her real name is Seira[セイラ].
